items.claim: CFO 表示 2026 年 LEAP 服務營收預期較先前財測上調約 10%，超過 35 億美元
items.quote: reaching over USD 3.5 billion
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示 2027 年 LEAP 增量營收預期比今年更強
items.quote: even stronger incremental revenue growth than this year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給 Q2 合併營收季增 7%~9% 的財測
items.quote: consolidated second quarter revenue should grow by 7% to 9%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給 Q2 ATM 營收季增 9%~11% 的財測
items.quote: should grow by 9% to 11% quarter-over-quarter
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給 Q2 ATM 毛利率 26%~27% 的財測
items.quote: second quarter gross margin should be between 26% to 27%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給 EMS Q2 營收年增至少 10% 的財測
items.quote: should grow at least 10% year-over-year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 維持一般（非 LEAP）封測營收成長約 13%，與去年相同
items.quote: repeat of last year's growth rate of about 13%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示調升今年資本支出，機台部分增加 6 億美元
items.quote: an incremental USD 0.6 billion in machinery
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明新增資本支出三分之二用於建物與廠房
items.quote: 2/3 of the increase of our CapEx is for building
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明新增機台支出中約 6 億用於晶圓針測，產能明年開出
items.quote: NTD 600 million worth of the CapEx is really for wafer sort
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示明年可能又是資本支出偏重的一年
items.quote: next year could be another CapEx heavy year for us
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示今年資金缺口主要以新增借款補足
items.quote: will mostly be funded by additional borrowing
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 不排除今年再度上調資本支出
items.quote: I wouldn't preclude that there will be a further need
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 管理層說明馬來西亞向 ADI 買下的廠房作為海外緩衝產能
items.quote: we've acquired a factory from ADI
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示 ATM Q1 毛利率 26% 高於原先預期的 24.5%
items.quote: ahead of our original expectation of 24.5%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: IR 說明今年折舊成長快於營收，因 LEAP 投資
items.quote: we see our depreciation rising faster than revenues
items.speaker: IR

items.claim: IR 說明合併毛利率季增主因為新台幣貶值
items.quote: primarily due to NT dollar depreciation
items.speaker: IR

items.claim: IR 表示 ATM 毛利率預期逐季上升，年底達結構性區間高端
items.quote: reach the higher end of our structural margins
items.speaker: IR

items.claim: CFO 說明 LEAP 機台大批裝機，爬坡期對毛利率造成壓力
items.quote: normally creates a some of -- some pressure on the margin
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示不調升結構性毛利率區間，待情況穩定再檢視
items.quote: we will rather wait until things are more settled
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示尚未提供折舊稀釋的量化，下季可能提供
items.quote: Maybe we can have that for you next quarter.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: IR 揭露 ATM 占合併營收 65%、占營業利益 91%
items.quote: represented 65% of our consolidated holding company revenue
items.speaker: IR

items.claim: CFO 結語承諾明年情況較穩定時檢視結構性毛利率區間
items.quote: we will be reviewing our structural margin range
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示會持續投資、不吝於擴充產能與研發
items.quote: we're certainly not going to be shy
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明 LEAP 組成約七成五為封裝、兩成五為測試
items.quote: about 75% in assembly and 25% in tests
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示 full process 今年營收仍預期達 3 億元
items.quote: reach this NTD 300 million revenue mark for this year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示 full process 理論上對 LEAP 毛利有加成
items.quote: in theory, it should be accretive to LEAP
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示面板級封裝已有全自動試產線送客戶驗證
items.quote: a fully automated pilot line for customer qualification
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示 CPO 尚無營收數字
items.quote: Right now, we don't have a number for it.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示 CPO 何時、多少營收貢獻現在說還太早
items.quote: it's a bit premature to say when and how much
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示測試資源聚焦晶圓針測而非 final test
items.quote: focusing our resources in wafer sort at this point
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示兩棟新取得廠房皆供 LEAP，明年初起逐步爬坡
items.quote: ramping up progressively starting from early next year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示多家客戶要求 full process 產能
items.quote: multiple customers requesting for this kind of capacity
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: IR 表示客戶偏好製造確定性
items.quote: customers prefer manufacturing certainty
items.speaker: IR

items.claim: CFO 表示 Q1 營收並非客戶提前拉貨所致
items.quote: I don't think it's because of the customers' early pull-in
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示不直接回答是否漲價，但成本上升可完全轉嫁
items.quote: those can be fully passed through
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示 PC 與手機市場疲弱持續
items.quote: PC and cellphone market softness continues
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: IR 表示產能與上游晶圓代工夥伴產能有限
items.quote: finite with limited ability to be pulled forward
items.speaker: IR

qa_flags.question: Haas Liu 追問可否量化新技術爬坡成本對 Q1、Q2 及下半年毛利率的稀釋（如 50~100bp）
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未給數字，只說有折舊占比擴大、尚未能量化，改說下季可能提供

qa_flags.question: Gokul Hariharan 追問既然毛利率已達結構區間高端，為何不上調結構性毛利率區間
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未直接回答是否上調，改說事情變動快、等穩定後明年再看

qa_flags.question: Charlie Chan 追問是否主動漲價
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 表示無法直接回答是否漲價，只說會依毛利要求訂價、成本可轉嫁

qa_flags.question: Gokul Hariharan 追問 2027 年 LEAP 增量是否至少 20 億元以上、是否達 55 億
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 不給具體數字，只說 20 億是基準、動能會更強
